Game modes
* I'm not sure whether Reverse mode is suitable for this clash, but let's see what others think.

Cases
* Please remove trailing newlines from the inputs and outputs of all cases.

* For Test/Validator 12, please include some instances where the threshold is reached exactly (in both directors, i.e. greater and smaller), as well as others where it falls short of the threshold by exactly 1 (again, in both directions).

Thanks.
